name: Amp Chantant
description: Virtuose de la Résonance créant des boucles de feedback destructrices visant les armures et les équipements sensibles aux vibrations.

subject.archetype: Resonance Combat Android – Ascetic Synth-Priest Warrior

loadout.armor_outfit: Monastic synthetic robe of braided cable fibers over patinated steel plates, ceramic white faceless mask, integrated holographic gold rune tattoos, ceremonial braided cable chapelet.
loadout.arsenal: Electrified pilgrim's resonance staff with crackling arcs, harmonic gauntlets projecting red energy tendrils, siphoning enemy vitality.

attitude.behavior: Predatory lunge forward, hand extended like a claw, red energy tendrils erupting from fingertips, whole body vibrating at resonant frequency causing air ripples; crystal shards exploding around.
attitude.emotion: Cold, serene cybernetic focus; relentless combat drive.

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Cinematic directional light with rim lighting on the figure, holographic gold glow from runes, red tendril emission, ambient blue crystal reflections, high contrast.

camera.angle: low angle with slight Dutch tilt for dynamic impact

scenography.setting: Shattered crystalline amphitheater turned battlefield; broken crystal pillars, jagged formations, cracked ceiling resonating, fragments raining.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Visible shockwave rings expanding from resonant overload, crystal shards exploding outward, air distortion ripples, red energy tendrils siphoning enemy strength, holographic gold runes orbiting the warrior.
